title: 159th Fighter Wing help Hurricane Harvey flood evacuees
description: Louisiana Air National Guard members provide support for local authorities to have command and control for flood evacuation operations in Vidor, Texas.  Actions were taken to transition to evacuees to shelter and assist the immediate needs of families rescued from flood waters brought by Hurricane Harvey, August 31, 2017. Soundbites: Sr. Master Sgt. Rosalie Huff, 159th Fighter Wing, Louisiana Air National Guard; Sr. Airman Christopher Walker, 159th Fighter Wing, Louisiana Air National Guard.
keywords: evacuees, 159th Fighter Wing, Louisiana Air National Guard, Vidor, Hurricane Harvey, Texas, flood
